---
# Caddie cover-letter template (ADR 0010). `caddie render cover-letter
# <slug>` copies this directory into a temporary one, writes _caddie-body.md
# (the verified letter) and _caddie.json (name, location, email, phone,
# links) next to it, then runs
# `quarto render cover-letter.qmd --to typst --output <Name>-cover-letter-…pdf`.
# The header comes from _caddie.json; the letter itself is the body alone.
from: markdown-smart-citations-tex_math_dollars-raw_tex-raw_html-raw_attribute+lists_without_preceding_blankline
format:
  typst:
    shift-heading-level-by: 0
    template-partials:
      - typst-template.typ
      - typst-show.typ
filters:
  - caddie-fields.lua
caddie-layout: letter
---

{{< include _caddie-body.md >}}
